We are Team possible – the people behind Davinsi Labs, Proximus, Proximus NXT, Codit, Proximus Ada, and more. Nice to see you here!United by a shared purpose, we’re building a smarter, trustful and more connected world. That means embracing technology and celebrating change. We think possible and then make it possible. And of course, we love what we do. Sounds like your kind of place?

Your job

What can you expect from this role? 

You will be part of our MSP teams focusing on Managed Detection and Response (MDR). The SRE team focuses on the backend platformization and automation side of the MDR service. Aspects like reliability, scalability, automation and efficiency of our managed service provider (MSP) technology stack are extremely important for Davinsi Labs. Your primary objective as an engineer will be to continuously enhance these capabilities across different complex customer environments. Your expertise and performance will directly impact the experience of our valued clients. The most relevant technologies for the SRE team are the following ones: 

• AWS
• GitHub
• Nutanix Prism
• HashiCorp Terraform
• HashiCorp Vault
• HashiCorp Cloud Platform (HCP)
• Ansible
• Microsoft Entra ID
• Microsoft Azure
• PingIdentity PingOne for customers
• Rocky Linux
Key responsibilities: 

• Design and implementation: You will be designing and implementing zero-touch production concepts across all levels of our MSP technology stack, leveraging applications Splunk Enterprise, Splunk Enterprise Security, Cribl Stream and Palo Alto Cortex XSOAR automation and orchestration capabilities to enhance operational efficiency. You will also be designing and implementing cloud infrastructure architecture, with a focus on AWS, Nutanix Prism, Microsoft Azure and Rocky Linux. This also includes IAM solutions, such as Single Sign-On (SSO), based on Microsoft Entra ID and PingIdentity PingOne.
• Automation: You'll develop automation capabilities for all value services, through CI/CD pipelines design and development.
• Version Control & Release Management: You'll be managing version control effectively using platforms such as GitHub. On the other hand, you'll be utilizing release management tools to streamline software deployment processes.
• Secret Management Solutions: Implementing secret management solutions like HashiCorp HCP Vault for MSP backends.
• Documentation: Generating and automating documentation using tools like Atlassian Confluence to ensure comprehensive system documentation. 

Your profile

 Hello, is it me you're looking for? 

• You have a strong background in computer science, computer engineering, or IT security (a degree is an asset).
• Experience with some of the following technologies: AWS, Microsoft Azure, Rocky Linux, Ansible, HashiCorp product portfolio, Microsoft Entra ID and PingIdentity PingOne.
• Experience with one or more of the following is highly recommended: Git, Atlassian Jira, Atlassian Confluence, Python v3, JavaScript.
• Affinity with threat detection platforms like SIEM technologies (Splunk, Sentinel, Elastic Stack, etc) and/or XDR technologies (Microsoft Defender XDR, Palo Alto Cortex XDR, etc) is an asset.
• You communicate in Dutch and English, both written and spoken. French is an asset.
• You are a problem solver with an analytical mind. As a team player with a positive attitude, you are always ready to challenge and to be challenged.

Nando isn't just another restaurant, it's Nonna's kitchen, brought to life in Wilrijk, Antwerp. Retro details, honest Italian comfort food, and a room that feels like family. We're looking for a

Restaurant is open 7/7, with 2 days off per week.

jobs.occupation: Finance Officer | Mandarin & English | International group
jobs.description:
Are you a 
Finance professional with experience in Belgian accounting and a strong interest in an international environment? Do you speak 
Mandarin and English and enjoy acting as the link between different finance teams? Are you looking for a role where you can combine your accounting knowledge with 
international collaboration, communication and coaching?
 

 
 

You will join a 
dynamic international industrial group with activities across different markets and a strong presence in both Europe and Asia. Despite its international scale, the organisation maintains 
short communication lines and a personal, family-oriented approach. You will become an important link between the finance team in the 
Waregem region and the finance team in China, giving you a unique opportunity to work across cultures and finance environments.
 

 
 

About the company
 

The organisation is part of a 
large international industrial group with activities across multiple countries. The Belgian organisation operates in a 
dynamic and entrepreneurial environment where collaboration, innovation and continuous improvement are encouraged. You will work closely with colleagues in Belgium and China and play an important role in ensuring smooth communication between both finance teams.
 

 
 

Your responsibilities as Finance Officer:
 
 

• You follow up on 
purchase and sales invoices, payments and outstanding items and ensure that the Belgian finance administration is processed accurately and on time. 
This gives you a hands-on role with direct ownership of important accounting processes. 

• You perform and monitor 
bank bookings and financial transactions, while keeping the accounting records accurate and up to date. 
You will further strengthen your practical accounting expertise within an international environment. 

• You act as the 
financial point of contact between the Belgian site and the finance team in China, translating questions, clarifying processes and ensuring that information flows smoothly between both locations. 
This gives you broad international exposure and allows you to build a strong network across two finance organisations. 

• You support and 
coach finance colleagues in China on Belgian accounting principles, processes and reporting requirements. 
You can use your own experience to help colleagues develop while simultaneously strengthening your communication and coordination skills. 

• You will occasionally 
travel to China to strengthen collaboration with the local finance team and support the alignment of processes. 
This offers you valuable international experience and the opportunity to work directly with colleagues on-site.  

 
 

Profile requirements as Finance Officer:
 
 

• You have practical experience within 
Belgian accounting and are familiar with 
BE GAAP. 

• You speak 
Mandarin Chinese and English fluently, allowing you to communicate effectively with both the Belgian and Chinese finance teams. 

• Knowledge of 
Dutch is a nice-to-have. 

• You are comfortable working in an international and multicultural environment. 

• You have a 
coordinating and communicative personality and enjoy acting as a bridge between different teams. 

• You are willing to 
travel to China occasionally as part of your role.

jobs.occupation: Senior RF/MMW – Analog and Mixed Signal IC Researcher
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced IC design researcher who can participate actively in the innovation and design of advanced RF/mmw and high speed (Gs/s) integrated circuits in the most advanced CMOS and IIIV technologies.
Apply 
 

Company
 

Imec performs world-leading research in nano-electronics. Imec leverages its scientific knowledge with the innovative power of its global partnerships in ICT, healthcare and energy. Imec delivers industry-relevant technology solutions. In a unique high-tech environment, its international top talent is committed to providing the building blocks for a better life in a sustainable society. Over 5000 expert scientists from over 95 countries shape tomorrow’s world with their research which is typically 5 to 10 years ahead of the market. Imec is headquartered in Leuven (Belgium) and has offices in the Netherlands, Taiwan, US, China, Japan and India. 
The Imec RF/mmWave and High-Speed ADC group in Leuven enjoys a world-class reputation in advanced high speed ADC and in millimeter-wave (mm-wave) RF Designs. In these fields our expertise is in the design of record-breaking high sampling rate ADCs and integrated RF/mm-wave front-ends in advanced CMOS and III-V based technologies. The design group also performs research in the fields of circuit design for advanced (optical) wireline communication, future RF technologies, mm-Wave sensing for life sciences, and mm-Wave imaging. 
The circuit design group is technically mentored by Piet Wambacq and Jan Craninckx and has an established state-of-the-art research reputation that has been confirmed over the years by our extensive presence in top conferences in solid-state circuit design, such as ISSCC, RFIC, ESSCIRC, VLSI and CICC. 
 
As an independent research center, we collaborate closely with top players in both industry and academia, giving our people continuous exposure to both the latest evolutions in industrial challenges and approaches, as well as into the newest emerging academic ideas and paradigms.
 

What you will do
 

We are looking for an experienced IC design researcher who can participate actively in the innovation and design of advanced RF/mm-wave and high speed (Gs/s) integrated circuits in the most advanced CMOS and IIIV technologies. 
 

Your key responsibilities will be: 
 
 

• Research and design of innovative high-speed, low-power RF and analog/mixed-signal integrated circuits in advanced CMOS and IIIV technologies.  

• Drive the bottom-up evolution of these integrated circuits considering the evolution of scaling.  

• Together with the team, bring new ideas and new technical innovations based on your solid technical experience.  

• Take part in technical interactions with external partners and towards new prospects.  

• Publish your state-of-the-art research results in international conferences or journals.  

Who you are
 
 

• You have a PhD degree in the domain of high-speed analog/mixed-signal and RF/mm-wave IC design or equivalent through experience.  

• You have solid design experience, and you have designed in advanced CMOS technologies (28nm, 16nmFF, 5nm).  

• You have experience designing in IIIV technologies.  

• You have a profound understanding of transistor-level circuits.  

• Experience in state-of-the-art high-speed analog/RF circuit design is a strong plus.  

• You are familiar with the various steps and tools in the design and layout of high performant analog and mixed signal circuits  

• You have solid understanding of solid-state devices, analog/RF circuits, up to the system architecture.  

• You have a broad interest in circuit design and are willing to contribute to multiple high speed analog circuit research domains  

• You can work independently yet in close collaboration with experts from other technical fields.  

• You have excellent reporting skills and can present technical results and choices clearly and concisely.  

• You can easily integrate into an international team.  

• Since you will be working in a highly international environment and will be maintaining a good contact with colleagues and co-workers from all over the world, fluency in English is essential.

EOC Group is growing its hotmelt adhesives business (Exomelt), as part of a portfolio of startups and new ventures. We are looking for a hands-on, dynamic Technical Service & Development Specialist to be the technical face of hotmelts to our customers, translating their applications, processes and specifications into the right hotmelt solution, and driving technical business development on the ground. 

You will need a thorough, practical understanding of hot melt adhesives and some formulation know-how of your own, but you won't be doing deep chemistry alone. You can lean on a team of formulation and chemistry specialists to turn your technical offers into robust products. This is a customer-facing, solution-oriented role for someone who is as comfortable on a customer's production line as in a technical discussion.

 

What will you do?

• You understand customers' applications, processes and specifications in depth, and translate them into the right hotmelt solution and a compelling technical offer.
• You drive technical business development, identifying and pursuing opportunities with new and existing customers in a hands-on, dynamic way.
• Once a solution is proposed, you support customers with in-line application advice, helping them run and troubleshoot hotmelt products on their equipment.
• You act as the technical liaison between customers and EOC's formulation and chemistry specialists, briefing the team on customer requirements and translating technical results back to customers.
• You provide training to agents and distributors who are intensively used to market our products.
• You track technical market trends and innovations in hotmelt adhesives, and bring relevant insights back into EOC's product and technology roadmap.
• You represent EOC and the Hotmelts business at industry conferences and trade shows, building EOC's technical reputation and network in the hotmelt adhesives market.

Who are you? 

• You bring a thorough understanding of hotmelt adhesives (EVA, APAO, rubber-based, polyolefin, or similar hotmelt technologies) and their end-use applications.
• You have working formulation know-how, enough to have credible technical conversations and shape a technical offer, while relying on specialists for detailed formulation work.
• You hold a chemistry degree or equivalent technical qualification (preferred).
• You are hands-on and dynamic, with a genuine drive for technical business development, comfortable owning a customer relationship from technical scoping through to in-line support.
• You communicate and build relationships strongly across customers, internal specialists, and management.
• You are willing and able to travel approximately 50% of the time, mainly shorter trips to customer sites, conferences and trade shows, not extended multi-week travel.
• You have a self-starting mindset suited to a startup environment, comfortable with ambiguity and building processes as the business scales.
You are fluent in English and German; additional European languages are an asset given EOC's customer base.

Your role

As a Maintenance Technician in the fixed night shift, you are essential to our production process. You ensure that machines operate at their best, perform preventive maintenance, and resolve malfunctions quickly and effectively. With your technical skills and problem-solving mindset, you keep the production running even while the world sleeps.

What will you do?

• Carry out preventive and corrective maintenance on machines and installations.

• Detect, analyze, and fix malfunctions (primarily electrical, ideally with mechanical expertise).

• Start up and optimize production lines.

• Actively contribute to improving the reliability and efficiency of the equipment.

• Collaborate with a team and report to the technical service manager.

Work schedule

• 2 workdays (2 x 7.36 hours) and 2 weekend days (2 x 11 hours), offering a steady yet varied schedule.
